note: Reviewed development classes for New Launches catalogue developments the Groundwork registry does not hold yet. Used only where data/registry/index.json has no entry for the slug; the registry (URA transactions) always wins. cls: condo (Condominium or Apartment) or ec. Each entry states its basis.

eden-residences-at-capitol.basis: The same development as the URA register entry EDEN RESIDENCES CAPITOL (Stamford Road, D06, 99 yrs from 2011), class condo.

lucerne-grand.basis: URA Sale Site, Lakeside Drive, awarded June 2025 to CDL Polaris (a URA private residential site; EC sites are tendered by HDB). 99 yrs from 2025.

seascape-at-sentosa.basis: The same development as the URA register entry SEASCAPE (Cove Way, D04, 99 yrs from 2007), class condo.

sophia-meadow.basis: 103-year lease from 2024 (an EC lease is always 99 years); homes on several storeys in one block (OneMap building record; developer listing levels reviewed privately).

the-ritz-carlton-residences.basis: The same development as the URA register entry THE RITZ-CARLTON RESIDENCES SINGAPORE CAIRNHILL (Cairnhill Road, D09, Freehold), class condo.

the-serra-residences.basis: Freehold (an EC is always 99-year leasehold); 133 homes in one 28-storey tower (Far East Organization media release, 2 Oct 2026).
